provenance.split_strategy: Disjoint prompt templates per split (8/2/2 of 12 per family); held-out fault types 10-12 only in the unseen-fault split.
limitations: Sandbox agent with a fixed ten-step DAG; production traces will be noisier.
Injected faults are realistic but synthetic; natural failures come from the configured LLM provider.
LLM-judge baselines run on a subset of test runs to limit cost.

natural_failures_source: sandbox agent (rule-based LLM stand-in with 7% mistake rate); GPT-6 Luna made 0 natural failures in 793 runs
cross_provider_note: Models trained on sandbox data only, tested on all 2,118 GPT-6 Luna failed runs

in_domain_lightgbm_5fold_cv.note: Trained on Who&When itself with 5-fold cross-validation by case (no case in its own training fold).

paper_reference.source: Zhang et al., 'Which Agent Causes Task Failures and When?' ICML 2025 (arXiv:2505.00212)
paper_reference.note: Prompted-LLM step-level accuracy reported in the paper is roughly 8-25% depending on method/model; agent-level is up to ~54%. Different protocol details apply; not a like-for-like comparison.

who_and_when.notes: Zero-shot transfer: no Who&When data was used for training. Traces longer than 24 steps are scored by M2+M3 only (Transformer positional limit).
